derivation: The frozen attempt definition is pass_attempt & !sack & !spike. nflverse leaves qb_dropback at 0 on a small number of rows that satisfy it anyway: two-point conversion passes (7 of the 9), one replay-reversed sack inside a penalty no_play, and one blocked field goal carrying pass_attempt = 1. The residual must equal that enumerated set exactly; the tolerance is the count of those rows, not a percentage.
